== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[The Last Horizon]] is a legendary starship characterized by its organic, bird-of-prey appearance. Measuring between four hundred and five hundred yards in length, the vessel features smooth metal hull plates that can glow in various colors such as blue-green, purple, or green. While some consider the ship a myth, it is regarded as an original exemplar of starship design, possessing [[Aethertech]] weaponry that rivals the power of massive dreadnoughts despite its smaller size. Its construction is described as being grown rather than built, and it may function as a single [[Zenith Device]]. The ship is said to possess extraordinary, though sometimes contradictory, abilities including the capacity to terraform entire systems, [[construct]] colonies instantly, freeze planetary motion, pierce planets, and transport crew across the galaxy without using [[Subspace]]. It is also rumored to be capable of creating entire fleets. The vessel is inhabited by several [[World Spirits]], one of whom is a horned woman known as [[Horizon]]. [[Horizon]] serves as the ship's consciousness and can manifest physically or as a multi-colored holographic projection to interact with the crew. The ship's history includes significant feats, such as defeating a world-threatening entity and retrieving a rogue rover from a realm of nightmares. Legends associate the ship with various magical enchantments from [[Archmagi]] and an astral [[dragon]], and it has been linked to the human [[Varic Vallenar|Archmage Varic Vallenar]]. The ship's internal structure includes containment rooms, a sealed [[vault]], and specialized decks for its crew, which may include roles such as an [[Engineer]] and a [[Pilot]].}}
